B"H

# Better Pass — Deployment Risk Plan

The Awtsmoos renews every authored file while Git and deployment decide whether production can receive the vessel;
Awtsmoos.com must never again let a locally visible module vanish from the deployed tree by an obsolete ignore-level spell.

## Risk Map

- Newly unignored `geelooy/scripts/awtsmoos/` files may include legitimate source, tests, or local-only artifacts.
- Concurrent agents may have changed unrelated files that the user explicitly asked to include.
- Deployment may be driven by GitHub, a workflow, a publish script, a server checkout, or multiple stages.
- A push is not proof of deployment.
- A deployment is not proof of browser correctness.

## Required Closure

- Capture full branch/HEAD/remotes/status.
- Enumerate all formerly ignored source now exposed to Git.
- Scan candidate tracked changes for secrets, local absolute paths, large/generated artifacts, and obvious runtime debris.
- Read deployment scripts/workflows/config before invoking anything.
- Stage all safe requested + related + unrelated work as requested, excluding secrets/generated/local-only hazards.
- Commit with an evidence-oriented message.
- Push canonical GitHub branch and verify remote SHA.
- Execute the real deployment mechanism.
- Verify production returns JavaScript MIME for the exact Apps URLs that previously failed.
- Verify `/portal/` and Portal API production routes from browser + HTTP.

## NEXT_ACTION

Do not stage or push until verification is green and the complete changed tree has been classified for deployment safety.
